title: Financial Policy and Assignment of Benefits
about: Payment responsibilities, insurance billing and assignment of benefits.

licence.terms: GPL-3.0-or-later, as the module. Adapt it for your clinic.

blocks.text: {facility.name} will bill my insurance for my care. I will pay any copay, coinsurance or deductible. I will also pay for care my insurance does not cover.
I assign my insurance benefits for my care to {facility.name}. I allow the clinic to share the information needed to process my claims.
If paying is hard for me, I may ask about payment plans and any discount program the clinic offers.

blocks.label: I have been told about
items: The clinic's discount or sliding fee program, if it has one

fields.label: If signed by a representative: name
